title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode6 Enjoy What You Like

meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Line: A few minutes later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... What would Shizuku like for her present?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So many good candidates, but none really stand out above the rest.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm really sorry about being so indecisive...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
Browsing's been super fun, and I really want Shizuku to enjoy what she gets.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Hey, they have animal brooches over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Look at that!
They've got dogs, cats... And they're all really cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Does Shizuku have a favorite animal?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Umm... She likes these birds called long-tailed bushtits. I'm guessing they don't have those...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, rabbits...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rabbits?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something about them brings us together. In the past we've made rabbit-shaped dango, snow rabbits and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Really...?
Hehe. That's so precious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, let's try looking for one!
Rabbits, bunnies...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aha! Look here!
This one's got jewels embedded in its eyes and ears!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's even got a fluffy cotton ball for a tail!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh...
Nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, this brooch might be nice...
It isn't a gaudy color or anything, so she should be able to wear it on a daily basis.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? Woohoo!
Then, you wanna go with this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do. Thank you for all your help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You two also, Saki, Yuki. I really appreciate what you did.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
I'm glad you were able to find something nice for her!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. Anyway, I'll take this up to the—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...!
They've got that brooch in a few different colors!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think this color would work really well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You think so...?
I thought this other one would look nice on her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, not her!
I was talking about you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Can you try it on for me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I'm good...
I don't usually wear these sorts of things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huuuh?
But you just said they're cute.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I didn't...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Don't lie!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whenever we go out shopping together, even though she really likes them deep down, Shiho never tries on anything that she thinks is cute.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
To be fair, everyone has their own style.
You might like something that you find, but not necessarily want to wear it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, true...
It's a little unfortunate since I really wanted to see you try this brooch on, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm taking Shizuku's brooch up front...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I'll go with you! I also found some accessories that I really like!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, we'll be waiting outside!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Still, it's kind of a shame...
Shiho really seemed to like these brooches.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, she's more the cool and collected type as opposed to cute and cuddly. So, I kinda get her objections...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But you can wear brooches a million different ways. I've gotta think there's a trick out there for getting this brooch to look good on Shiho.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: You seem unsure about something.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Nothing gets by you, Sis.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was just wondering if there are any good ways for Shiho to make use of that brooch we just saw.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, I see. She could conceivably pin it to a hat or bag without having it stand out too much. She could also turn it into a keychain of some sort!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why I personally think it's kind of a shame that she isn't getting it. She actually seems to have a soft spot for cute things...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know that feeling of excitement that comes over you when you put on something you think is cute? How can you not smile, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then, why not tell Shiho that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, but... Wouldn't that make me too pushy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, Sis, you just said it yourself.
Everyone has their own style.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Yes, I did.
But she may want to try it out if you tell her about some of the ideas we just talked about, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Also, don't you want her to get more joy from the things that she loves deep down...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then, why don't you go over to her and give her some suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I believe that any person's possibilities are endless. The choice is ultimately Shiho's, but you should at least tell her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Endless possibilities...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Sis.
I'll go try telling her!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Okay, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Sis really is an amazing person...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Now then!)
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, about that brooch...
Mind if I gave you a quick presentation about it?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A presentation...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I get that you think it's a little too cute for you, but I think there's a way to get around that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For example, instead of pinning it onto your clothes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, cool!
I never thought about using a brooch as a keychain!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I figured that you'd be able to use this brooch more often if it were like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You have a point...
A keychain for my bag does seem a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really love cute stuff like this.
Seeing these kinds of things always makes me feel better and gives me the energy I need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Shiho, if you like this brooch and think it's cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm really hoping that you'll get it and wear it in a way that you'd enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, I'll also get one for myself since it might be nice as a keychain...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?! You mean it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! That means you and Shizuku are gonna match!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's beside the point.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Then, here!
Your very own rabbit!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're gonna match... Come to think of it, we always used to wear the same clothes.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess it's still okay every once in a while...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Shizuku's gonna love your present so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I sure hope so...
